title: Rational design of fluorescent imaging agents for hepatic diseases: from molecular mechanisms to diagnostic precision
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,4121-4159
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00947B, Review Article
Yuantao Mao, Wen Zhang, Xin Wang, Ping Li, Bo Tang
This review summarizes recent advances (since 2020) in fluorescent probes for hepatic diseases, covering design, mechanisms, imaging applications, challenges, and future directions for precision diagnosis and treatment.
